## Find The Right Medical Services For You And Your Family

At Family Medical Group, trust is at the core of everything we do. We believe that our patients deserve not just good, but exceptional customer service and satisfaction. ### Our Vision

We strive to make world-class healthcare services available to all, with a focus on empathy, understanding, and the well-being of our patients and neighbors.

### Our Values

At the heart of our medical philosophy lies a commitment to integrity, compassion, and excellence. Every aspect of our care centers around serving our patients with the utmost inclusivity, respect, and empathy.

### Our Team

We have a rockstar team of healthcare experts who are committed to delivering top-notch, individualized care. We value building meaningful connections with our patients and their loved ones, and strive to make every visit a happy one.

## You have the right to receive a “ _Good Faith Estimate_” explaining how much your medical care will cost

Under the law, health care providers need to give patients who don’t have insurance or who are not using insurance an estimate of the bill for medical items and services. You have the right to receive a Good Faith Estimate for the total expected cost of any non-emergency items or services.

Make sure your health care provider gives you a Good Faith Estimate in writing at least 1 business day before your medical service or item. You can also ask your health care provider, and any other provider you choose, for a Good Faith Estimate before you schedule an item or service. If you receive a bill that is at least $400 more than your Good Faith Estimate, you can dispute the bill. Make sure to save a copy or picture of your Good Faith Estimate.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What services does our medical center provide for employers and workplace health needs?

Our medical center offers a full suite of occupational medicine services designed to keep your workforce healthy, compliant, and productive. We provide workplace medical screenings, including drug testing, audiogram testing, and pulmonary function testing, to help ensure employees meet the health and safety standards of their specific job roles. We also conduct fit for duty exams, DOT physicals, and respirator clearance exams, which are vital for positions involving safety-sensitive tasks or regulated environments.
Additionally, our team manages work injury case management, streamlining communication between employers, injured workers, and insurers for efficient recovery and return to work. Whether you're an HR professional or a small business owner, our occupational health solutions are tailored to support your company's well-being and regulatory compliance.



What is occupational medicine, and how can it benefit both employers and employees?

Occupational medicine is a specialized branch of medicine that focuses on the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of work-related injuries and illnesses. Our center's occupational medicine services help ensure that employees are physically capable of safely performing their job duties, which benefits both the individual and their employer. Through workplace medical screenings, fit for duty exams, DOT physicals, and respirator clearance exams, we evaluate each employee’s physical health in relation to job requirements.
We also offer audiogram testing and pulmonary function testing to monitor long-term workplace exposure risks. If an injury occurs, our work injury case management program coordinates care, treatment, and documentation, helping the employee recover while reducing downtime and claim costs for the employer. Ultimately, occupational medicine helps maintain a healthy, safe, and efficient workplace environment.


How do we support employees who have been injured on the job?

When an employee suffers a workplace injury, our medical center offers immediate and ongoing support through comprehensive injury treatment and work injury case management. We provide same-day evaluations to determine the extent of injury and initiate a treatment plan tailored to the individual’s needs. Our providers are experienced in occupational health and understand the importance of returning employees to work safely and promptly. Our work injury case management team coordinates with employers, insurance providers, and the injured worker to facilitate effective communication, proper documentation, and follow-up care.
Additionally, if required, we conduct fit for duty exams to assess when the employee is ready to return to their position. With a focus on safety and recovery, we ensure that each injury case is handled with efficiency and compassion.


Do we offer medical exams for regulatory and immigration purposes?

Yes, our clinic provides a wide range of exams to meet regulatory and legal requirements. We offer DOT physicals for commercial drivers to meet Department of Transportation requirements, including drug testing and audiogram testing as needed. For respiratory or hazardous work environments, we conduct respirator clearance exams and pulmonary function testing to evaluate lung function and ensure safe respirator use. Additionally, we provide immigration physicals in compliance with USCIS guidelines, including required immunizations and a full medical evaluation by a civil surgeon. Whether you're applying for a commercial license or immigration status, our staff ensures a smooth, thorough, and compliant examination process from start to finish.


What general healthcare services are available for individuals and families?

In addition to occupational services, our medical center serves as a trusted provider of primary care and family health services. Our family doctors offer routine check-ups, chronic disease management, preventative care, and immunizations through our clinic, ensuring comprehensive care for patients of all ages. Whether you're in for an annual physical, managing conditions like diabetes or hypertension, or seeking immunizations, our providers are committed to your long-term health.
We integrate primary care with occupational medicine, so employees can receive personal and workplace-related healthcare in one convenient location. With our full-service approach, individuals and families receive personalized attention and continuity of care to stay healthy at home and on the job.

## Our services and treatments

We offer a full scope of services to anyone needing urgent care. Our knowledgeable staff works to help you find relief quickly.

### Medical examinations and tests

Specialized medical examinations are available for routine check-ups or sports physicals. We also offer a physicals for employees, such as Department of Transportation (DOT) physicals. Additionally, a full range of testing and screening options, including X-rays, are available.

### Pediatric health

If a child is suffering from a minor injury or illness, time may be of the essence. Our walk-in clinic is staffed with providers that offer comprehensive pediatric care to your little ones, ages 3 months and up. Services include treatment for rashes, wounds, fevers, ear and throat infections, allergies and pink eye.

### Medical procedures

You may need a minor medical procedure for instances that involve wounds or stitches. Our leading-edge clinics offer a safe, comfortable experience without long wait times.

### Immunizations

We make it easy for you to get the immunizations you need to stay healthy. These include, flu shots, various travel vaccines, tetanus shots and the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine.

### Preoperative evaluations

Before your surgery, preoperative evaluations can help you get valuable information and evaluate your risks for potential complications. Preoperative evaluations are usually done 30 days before your surgery and we have a seven-day turnaround period that allows us to check that any additional tests are received and reviewed.

### Your immigration physical, in a convenient location

When you’re seeking U.S. citizenship, a green card or immigration benefits, you need a medical exam with a United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS)-designated civil surgeon. MD Now® urgent care is proud to offer this exam to the Miami-Dade area, which includes a physical, a medical history evaluation and a check for communicable diseases.

Our civil surgeons will provide the USCIS with the necessary information to determine if you meet the health-related standards for admissibility. Keep in mind, this isn’t a comprehensive health checkup, but a screening focused on conditions relevant to U.S. immigration law.

You'll want to be sure to bring all relevant medical records, identification and Form I-693 Report of Immigration Medical Examination and Vaccination Record.

# Primary Care for Seniors

Your health is our primary concern, so we dedicate ourselves to providing the best primary care for seniors that money can buy. Seniors require attention, patience, and specialized medical knowledge for proper symptom management. For appropriate senior care, a physician doesn’t can’t simply consult the patient and prescribe medication every once in a while. We believe that ongoing personalized contact with a physician can significantly improve a senior’s quality of life and symptoms.

At Primary Medical Care Center, we focus on the person, not the medical condition. Every senior we take in is a human being with individualized needs and wants, and our physicians are deeply aware of that. When a senior makes frequent visits to our medical center, they receives better medical attention, better assistance with symptom management, and better health advice. This is what’s called a patient-centric approach, and we’re committed to it!
